allowed_inputs.role: frozen autonomous program and Campaign 3 envelope
finding-free review of the frozen autonomous program
immutable program state authorizing only Campaign 3 planning
content-addressed official schedule and publication metadata evidence
exact Normal, zero-cost, Stress A, and Stress B costs and embedded execution delays
finding-free review of the exact execution-cost model
second rejection and mandatory clean-room trace/input remediation

fingerprint_contract: Remove the top-level attestation_fingerprint field, canonicalize with systematic_trading_lab.fingerprints.canonical_json, and take SHA-256 of those UTF-8 bytes.

fixed_inherited_constraints.candidate_envelope: At most nine parents from exactly three fixed post-publication completed-bar observation horizons crossed with exactly three fixed joint positive reaction floors.
fixed_inherited_constraints.chronology: Use only the five exposed periods and context-only-session rule bound by the program. Complete each stage before merit read; never adapt from partial results.
fixed_inherited_constraints.data: Use only the program-bound exposed SPY and QQQ five-minute OHLCV dataset IDs plus the allowed metadata-only Federal Reserve artifacts. Do not acquire price or volume data.
fixed_inherited_constraints.execution: Long-only, completed-bar-only, state changes only, no leverage, one joint half-weight SPY/QQQ entry per eligible session, no reentry, flat at close, diagnostic zero cost only, and exact cost-model scenarios and embedded delays.
fixed_inherited_constraints.publication_time: Exactly 14:00 America/New_York on a full 78-bar XNYS session; publication bar index 54 becomes observable only after it completes.
fixed_inherited_constraints.stop_boundary: Stop after a nonempty all-gate cohort or Campaign 3 closeout. Campaign 4 is prohibited. No controlled range is currently eligible.

calendar_and_class_acceptance: Accept or reject the exhaustive calendar as a whole after checking both classes, every count, 14:00 local-time rule, full-session rule, uniqueness, and sample floor.
State whether statements and minutes may share one causal contract. Never select a class, date, period, or subset from market behavior.
If a calendar or class requirement fails, prescribe terminal pre-execution closure without widening, substitution, or market-data access.
causal_signal_and_execution: Choose the exact reaction formula, reference/terminal prices and indices, units, rounding, and threshold comparisons.
Choose exactly three observation horizons and exactly three positive reaction floors without using or reconstructing either rejected plan.
Define the joint activation rule, decision time, exact cost-model scenario mapping, entry fill indices, close-safe exit decision/fill indices, missed-fill rule, and flat-at-close failure behavior.
Define deterministic parent IDs, the complete grid, no-signal reasons, and the exact trace contracts.
gates_and_selection: Choose every discovery, walk-forward, combined-serious, stress, delay, and neighbor gate and threshold before market bars or results are read.
Cover Normal and zero-cost return, activity, event/class support, round trips, gross edge, cost ratio, drawdown, chronology, delay, accounting, and trace equality wherever defined.
Choose disqualifying session, event, period, and publication-class concentration metrics and thresholds. Mechanical half weights provide no diversification claim.
Choose complete-pair requirements, caps, non-result selection order, simultaneous cohort rule, undefined-metric action, and terminal dispositions.
neighbor_graph_and_budget: Choose an exact symmetric immediate-neighbor graph for both axes, including perturbations, domain/boundaries, IDs, and at most four neighbors for the one serious-candidate cap.
Choose each scenario and exact prospective run count. Prove discovery, walk-forward, stress/delay, neighbor, and total arithmetic at or below 90 with no prior-campaign transfer.
State which stage barriers open later work and resolve every tie without result-driven discretion.
failure_and_stop_rules: Choose exact dispositions for calendar defects, missing causal bars, binding mismatch, invalid parameters, undefined metrics, deterministic failure, publication conflict, partial output, and stale source.
Preserve exact expired-no-result retry semantics and the three-attempt ceiling. Never relabel deterministic data, candidate, control, or publication failure as infrastructure.
Keep authority false and prescribe cross-campaign synthesis plus the three-campaign stop after empty or interrupted Campaign 3.

input_control.committed_packet_rule: The architect may begin only after this attestation and all allowed inputs exist together at one pushed commit; the assignment must bind that commit and this file's SHA-256.
input_control.permitted_read_scope: This attestation and only the eight allowed_inputs paths at their exact SHA-256 values.
input_control.unlisted_input_rule: Do not read, search, infer from, or receive any unlisted repository path, external source, tool history, prior agent output, or conversation context.

isolation_attestation.coordinator_role: The coordinator may enforce inherited controls and mechanically encode the returned design, but may not select, suggest, rank, repair, or alter replacement scientific or execution choices.
isolation_attestation.planner_history: fresh architect with no inherited conversation turns
prohibited_inputs: either rejected plan, any copy, diff, deleted bytes, tool output, prior architect return, or description of its numerical/scientific choices
Federal Reserve release bodies, decisions, votes, projections, implementation notes, surprises, or revisions beyond allowed metadata
market bars, prices, returns, results, reports, attempt databases, reservations, or any .trading-lab path
June 2026, Intraday V3 A/B/C, daily 2018-2019, protected results, PAPER or broker state, strategic-allocation-21, or live data
conversation history or guidance from a prior plan author or reviewer
isolation_attestation.root_exposure_recorded: The coordinator has seen prohibited body text and both rejected designs; only the newly isolated architect may originate replacement choices.

mandatory_trace_separation.cross_scenario_trace: Define one explicitly versioned canonical pre-fill signal/decision payload that excludes scenario ID, cost, execution delay, intended fill index, fills, later prices, exit, P&L, and every output hash. Its output hash alone is used for Normal/zero/stress/delay equality and retention identity.
mandatory_trace_separation.execution_trace: Define a separate explicitly versioned scenario-specific execution payload containing scenario ID, cost-model scenario ID, execution delay, intended fill index, entry/exit decisions and fills, and required accounting identities. Its output hash is never required to equal another scenario.
mandatory_trace_separation.hash_output_rule: Each trace hash is the SHA-256 output of its canonical payload and is excluded from its own preimage. No trace payload may contain its own hash.
mandatory_trace_separation.retention_rule: Cross-scenario retention compares only runs whose cross_scenario_trace hashes match exactly; differing execution_trace hashes are expected.

output_contract.deliverable: One self-contained exact replacement recommendation, not alternatives and not a repository edit.
output_contract.encoding_rule: The coordinator must encode the recommendation without changing choices, bind the plan to this attestation and source commit, then obtain a new finding-free plan/calendar review before implementation or market-data read.
output_contract.rationale_rule: Give non-result-derived causal, sample-size, cost, and close-safety reasons for each numerical choice.
output_contract.rejection_rule: If the allowed evidence cannot support a valid plan, return terminal pre-execution rejection rather than filling gaps from outside sources.
required_sections: exact causal signal and parent grid
exact execution timing and split traces
exact failure, terminal, authority, and protected-boundary rules
